scripts.test:backend: PYTHONPATH=backend uv run --project backend pytest backend/tests
scripts.test:integration: PYTHONPATH=backend uv run --project backend pytest backend/tests -m integration
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.lint:backend: PYTHONPATH=backend uv run --project backend ruff check backend
scripts.format:backend: PYTHONPATH=backend uv run --project backend ruff format backend
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run lint:backend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
